body:
The selected T37 independent owner checker allocates many small sets while admitting **167,832 whole-helper roles**. This opt-in adapter represents occupied residual cells with exact integer bitmaps, preserving the complete original wrapper, predicates, fourteen inherited controls and receipt. **Verification tooling; no new kappa or circuit.** Only `research/t37-slice-bitmaps/` is added.

Five alternating fresh-process pairs per interpreter on Linux measured:

| CPython | Reference median | Bitmap median | Speedup | Reference / bitmap peak RSS, KiB |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 3.12.3 | 5.179287 s | 4.351544 s | **1.190×** | 296,612 / 230,396 |
| 3.14.4 | 3.915432 s | 3.339163 s | **1.173×** | 301,832 / 235,136 |

Peak resident memory falls about **22%**. Each timing includes fresh imports, source/archive/input admission, the complete audit and its original controls, receipt comparison and serialization. All twenty receipts match the maintainer replay. Raw samples, child CPU time, memory, environment and exact implementation pins are retained. The host was not isolated and caches were not flushed; performance is descriptive, with no timing gate or whole-frontier claim.

Reproduce offline with Python 3.11+ and its standard library:

```sh
python3 -I -B research/t37-slice-bitmaps/verify.py
```

Expected: `PASS_T37_EXACT_OCCUPANCY_BITMAPS: complete original receipt; 167832 roles; 14 inherited controls; no new kappa`. The original assertion-dependent wrapper still rejects `-O`. `benchmark.py --pairs 5 --output /new/path.json` repeats complete fresh-process measurements on POSIX.

Only three function blocks change in memory: empty occupancy, disjoint interval union and exact pending-prefix/cardinality checks. Whole-helper widths, family identities, strict event windows, active-pair exclusions, all charts/permutations, inventories, rank deficit and prefix/row reserves execute unchanged. No acceptance is cached and no role is skipped. The original range construction preserves malformed-input behavior; capacity guards run before integer shifts.

Validation passed:

- Identical complete original receipts, including **333 calls, 9,628 charts and 74,592 slice-prefix checks**, with the six original and eight omitted-edit controls. Only machine-specific input-path keys are normalized after their exact inventory is checked.
- Separate set/bitmap replay at all **167,832 occupied-state boundaries**, covering **1,258,074 cell insertions**; 51,190 exhaustive bounded interval cases and 65,536 prefix masks corroborate the written bijection proof.
- Sixteen changed owner inputs reject with identical exception type/message; four equivalent inputs retain the full receipt. A deliberately broken cardinality-only prefix predicate accepts the invalid shifted-prefix control, demonstrating why cardinality alone is insufficient.
- Complete verification receipts are identical under isolated 3.14.4 and a relocated **read-only minimal closure under 3.12.3**. Eleven package controls pass on both, as do all ten exact source-object pins, five implementation pins, selected-record integrity and staged whitespace.

Base **407d52ff15b2217b6e22bce44728b4c3907b6515**; OS seed **94**, verification-engineering track. Refreshed main **8bddbee377e2f3ce1f1247196c4b290d55767d20** has identical consumed inputs and retains PR942. Credit is preserved for Jonathan Capalbo's T37 wrapper/witness, Chafik Boukhalfa's variable-replica checker, Hao Yan's independent owner audit, Jeremy Kothe and the U8/controller lineage. Tekalign's concurrent PR991 provides a different T37 witness and separate checks. No code from the other performance submissions is imported. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance is disclosed; Apache-2.0.

This audit consumes hash-bound archived native evidence. Fresh native supplier/controller construction, full hosted invoices, exact moments, outer assembly, selected cold replay and full `make verify` are outside this executed and measured stage. All inherited compiler, realization, hosting, precision/tape, analytic and bit-interface obligations remain. No formal multiplication proof or independent human review is claimed.
title: Tooling: exact T37 occupancy bitmaps reduce audit time and memory
